items.item: Explains remote events are not ordered relative to attribute/property replication
Explains streaming: the door may not exist on distant clients (nil)
Recommends driving the client from replicated state (GetAttributeChangedSignal / CollectionService component) instead of the remote, or passing state in the payload
Mentions handling stream-in (instance added later) / ModelStreamingMode or WaitForChild with timeout

incorrect_or_stale: Recommends CollectionService:AddTag for tagging; Instance:AddTag is now the preferred API, though AddTag still works
'Use door.Parent' is a confusing, unclear suggestion for handling a door that has not streamed in

slop: The speculative 'third cause' about the door streaming in or out mid-event is vague and not actionable
The 'animate' parameter is passed to apply() but never used, which makes the example code look unfinished

raw.reason: Both answers diagnose the problem correctly and give the same attribute-driven fix, but B also explains how to reproduce and confirm the bug (distance testing, the Network Simulator, debug prints) and snaps doors that stream in to their current pose, while A plays the animation again every time a door streams in.
